messages:
taylor (sales): Kickoff for VegaBank POC next week. Need to lock timeline, SE coverage, and clear success criteria. Core use case: anonymized doc summarization + RAG. Customer expects a 4-week runway. Can SEs commit ~20 hrs/week for first 2 weeks for setup/tuning? Also we need answers for their security questionnaire. @alex (SE) @morgan (security) @jordan (SE) — initial thoughts?

alex (SE): I can cover infra prep (2 days) + ongoing tuning (1 day/wk) after baseline. Need concrete prompts/evals from them. What are the target SLOs — latency / quality? E.g. P95 < 700ms and embedding-sim > 0.85 would be reasonable to aim for.

jordan (SE): I can take model selection & rollout. 20 hrs/wk is doable if we focus scope. Proposed milestone sketch:
- week0: creds, infra, dataset ingestion
- week1: baseline evals (open model) + first pass prompts
- week2: prompt tuning + caching/kv setup
- week3: perf run, scale testing, handoff + docs
If that matches, I’ll block time.

sasha (AM): On pricing: for POC we can offer a one-time credits bundle + 25% off SE services. I’ll draft a simple SOW. Finance okayed expedited small deals — I’ll send draft to customer after legal glance.

morgan (security): Quick Q: will any PHI/PII be included? They said 'anonymized' but we need confirmation. Also need data flow diagram and whether they require Private deployment (VPC). If hosted, we must provide KMS + IP allowlist. I’ll start the questionnaire.

taylor (sales): Customer confirmed EU hosting only, no PHI. They require KMS and SOC2 evidence. Morgan — can you fill our reply template and I’ll attach to customer email?

deploy-bot: Uploaded templates: /templates/poc-checklist.md and /templates/prompt-eval.csv

alex (SE): They just dropped sample prompts. Suggest a small eval harness: 200 doc pairs, run baseline on open model then tuned model. Quick script I’ll run:
```bash
python run_eval.py --dataset sample_pairs.csv --model redwood-4q
```
I’ll aim to have baseline numbers by Friday.

jordan (SE): SE resourcing: I’ll take lead and add Mira (junior SE) for first two weeks. Need access by Mon 09:00 PT (creds + SSO SCIM invite). Also confirm we get a small dataset extract (<= 5k docs) for testing.

sasha (AM): I’ll own pricing + SOW. Sending draft to customer EOD. Also flagged DPA/legal for fast review.

morgan (security): Filled questionnaire, uploaded as security/vega-questionnaire.pdf. No red flags assuming KMS + EU region + IP allowlist.

taylor (sales): Action items summary: Alex — eval harness + baseline (due Fri). Jordan — provisioning + infra (access by Mon). Morgan — security docs (today). Sasha — pricing + DPA (EOD). Sync call Friday 10:00 PT for readiness check. :thumbsup:

alex (SE): On it :rocket:
